title: PsDiff
description: Deploy-tool-friendly Permission-Set / Profile grant diff emitted by sfi.compare_components when format='ps-diff' (P8-draft-ps-diff). Reshaped from the base fieldDiffs + edgeDiffs. PROPOSES a diff for a human to feed Gearset/Copado; it never deploys or writes to the org.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema the payload conforms to.

idA.description: Canonical id of the first component (the 'A' side).

idB.description: Canonical id of the second component (the 'B' side).

bothPermissionLike.description: True when both ids are a PermissionSet or Profile (the intended inputs).

changes.description: Every reshaped grant/setting change between A and B.

disclosure.description: Verbatim boundary disclosure (notes the read-edit level-change blind spot).

category.description: objectPermissions | fieldPermissions | classAccesses | userPermissions | metadata | otherGrants | <other property segment>.

key.description: Granted component id, user-permission name, or property path.

valueA.description: Prior value; present for change='changed' or 'removed'.

valueB.description: New value; present for change='changed' or 'added'.
